note: Source of truth for hand-deployed Lambdas (no CI). $LATEST = the dev alias for every function; staging/prod ride PUBLISHED versions. Pull-live before editing; deploy updates $LATEST (dev) only.

functions.name: ZoooomOfferNotification
functions.purpose: Inbox + SES notifier. Direct {eventType} dispatch: OFFER_*/PAYMENT_*/SALE_*/CONFIRM_SALE_REQUEST/LISTING_WITHDRAWN/SERVICE_REMINDER. Per-env via alias qualifier.

functions.name: ZoooomServiceReminder
functions.purpose: Daily maintenance-reminder sweep + ad-hoc {vin,userId} recompute. OEM MMYT schedule match/predict (min of miles|months). Invokes ZoooomOfferNotification SERVICE_REMINDER.

functions.name: ZoooomAddServiceRecord
functions.purpose: Scanned service-record add (+dedup). On success invokes SERVICE_REMINDER_FN {vin,userId} for instant schedule refresh.

functions.name: ZoooomAddServiceRecordManual
functions.purpose: Manual service-record add. On success invokes SERVICE_REMINDER_FN {vin,userId}.

functions.name: ZoooomDealOffer
functions.purpose: Deal/offer CRUD (POST /offers, /deals, GET /deals/{id}/offers, accept/counter/decline). putDeal strips empty GSI-key attrs (vin/sellerId/buyerId) so empty-vin offers don't 500 on VinIndex.

functions.name: ZoooomMessagingV3
functions.purpose: Inbox/chat + notification prefs. set_prefs/get_prefs write/read notificationPreferences on ZoooomUser (composite IdUser+email). Origin allowlist enforced.
